infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Loomi uses your location only when you turn on location sharing, to show your partner a friendly distance snapshot.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Loomi uses the microphone to record voice notes for your partner.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Loomi uses the camera so you can capture memories to share.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Loomi accesses your photo library so you can pick photos and videos for memories, journal and chat.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Loomi uses Face ID to unlock your Private Vault.
